title: Explicit adic derived inverse limit
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme with its small pro-etale site, constant sheaves of rings, and derived categories of sheaves of modules [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], let $\Lambda$ be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], and let $I=(f_1,\ldots,f_r)\subseteq\Lambda$ be a finitely generated ideal.  Put $P_n=\Lambda/I^n$ for $n\geq1$, with ideal powers and quotient rings as in [def-weil-pbc-algebra-hom-quotient]; assume that $\Lambda/I$ is torsion as an additive group (each element is killed by a positive integer) and that each $P_n$, in degree zero, is perfect over $\Lambda$ [def-pc-perfect-ring-complex].  Let $K\in D(X_{\mathrm{proet}},\Lambda)$, and define
$$K_n:=K\otimes^L_{\Lambda_X}(P_n)_X\in D(X_{\mathrm{proet}},P_n),$$
using the derived change of rings [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings], with underlying derived tensor as in [def-weil-derived-tensor], with $(P_n)_X$ and $\Lambda_X$ the constant sheaves of rings.  Regard each $K_n$ also as an object of $\mathcal D:=D(X_{\mathrm{proet}},\Lambda)$ by restriction of scalars [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars], and let $q_{n+1,n}:K_{n+1}\to K_n$ be induced by $P_{n+1}\twoheadrightarrow P_n$; these are the transitions of the reduction tower [def-weil-pbc-complete-coefficient-datum], an inverse system [def-weil-inverse-system].

Assume that $\mathcal D$ is triangulated with shift $[1]$ and distinguished triangles [def-weil-triangulated-category], and that the countable product $\prod_{n\geq1}K_n$ with projections exists [def-weil-category-product].  Let $s:\prod_nK_n\to\prod_nK_n$ be the transition endomorphism [def-weil-tower-transition-endomorphism], characterized by $\operatorname{pr}_n\circ s=q_{n+1,n}\circ\operatorname{pr}_{n+1}$.

An *adic derived inverse limit* of $K$ is a derived limit [def-weil-derived-limit] of this reduction tower, namely a triple $(L,p,\delta)$ consisting of an object $L\in\mathcal D$ and morphisms $p:L\to\prod_nK_n$ and $\delta:\prod_nK_n\to L[1]$ such that
$$L\xrightarrow{p}\prod_nK_n\xrightarrow{1-s}\prod_nK_n\xrightarrow{\delta}L[1]$$
is a distinguished triangle.  We may write $L=R\varprojlim_nK_n$ for any such chosen triple; this notation denotes a property with chosen triangle, not a canonically selected object or a functor.  No morphisms between chosen triples are specified by this definition.
